visual_blocks.title: Think Story
visual_blocks.content: The important numbers are 45 and 5. Equal sharing means division, so we calculate 45 ÷ 5 = 9. Each child gets 9 cookies.

visual_blocks.question: Mom has 42 snacks. She shares them equally into 6 bags. How many snacks are in each bag?
